## Libraries
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(sf)          # vector handling
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)        # map making
library(viridisLite)
```

## Data Details & Processing

```{r}
# NASA VIIRS data from 2021-02-07 and 2021-02-16.
h08v05_0207<- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif')
h08v06_0207<- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif')
h08v05_0216<- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif')
h08v06_0216<- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif')

# upload prepared a Geopackages 
roads <- read_sf('data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg')
buildings <- read_sf('data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg')
```

# Check CRS and resolutions

```{r}
cat("=== Tile 05 02/07/2021 ===\n")
cat("Resolution:", res(h08v05_0207), "\n")
cat("Extent:    "); print(ext(h08v05_0207))

cat("\n=== Tile 06 02/07/2021 ===\n")
cat("Resolution:", res(h08v06_0207), "\n")
cat("Extent:    "); print(ext(h08v06_0207))

cat("\n=== Tile 05 02/16/2021 ===\n")
cat("Resolution:", res(h08v05_0216), "\n")
cat("Extent:    "); print(ext(h08v05_0216))

cat("\n=== Tile 06 02/16/2021  ===\n")
cat("Resolution:", res(h08v06_0216), "\n")
cat("Extent:    "); print(ext(h08v06_0216))

cat("\n=== Same CRS? ===\n")
cat("roads vs buildings: ", same.crs(roads, buildings), "\n")
cat("Tile 05 vs Tile 06 (02-07-2021): ", same.crs(h08v05_0207, h08v06_0207), "\n")
cat("Tile 05 vs Tile 06 (02-16-2021): ", same.crs(h08v05_0216,h08v06_0216), "\n")
```

## Data Merging 

```{r}
# Match extent for VIIRIS data
h08v06_0207<- extend(h08v06_0207, h08v05_0207)
h08v06_0216 <- extend(h08v06_0216,h08v05_0216)
```

```{r}
# Merge tiles together to get one raster for each date (2021-02-07 and 2021-02-16)
VIIRS_07<- (merge(h08v05_0207, h08v06_0207)) 
VIIRS_16<- (merge(h08v05_0216, h08v06_0216)) 


```

## Create Blackout Mask 

```{r}
# Set all cells with values less than 200 nW cm-2sr-1 to NA
VIIRS_07[VIIRS_07 < 200] <- NA
VIIRS_16[VIIRS_16 < 200] <- NA

houston_ext <- ext(-96.5, -94.5, 29, 30.5)

# Subset raster based on mask
VIIRS_07_mask <- mask(VIIRS_07, mask = houston_ext)
VIIRS_16_mask <- mask(VIIRS_16, mask = houston_ext)

plot(VIIRS_07_mask)

VIIRS_07_mask_V <- VIIRS_07_mask |> 
  as.polygons() |> 
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_transform(crs = 3083)

VIIRS_16_mask_V <- VIIRS_16_mask |> 
  as.polygons() |> 
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_transform(crs = 3083)

```

```{r}
print(crs(VIIRS_07_mask_V))
print(crs(VIIRS_16_mask_V))
```
```{r}
plot(VIIRS_07_mask_V)
plot(VIIRS_16_mask_V)
```
